newsitem.title: USA: Krause's gains $1.7 mln in equity capital.
newsitem.headline: Krause's gains $1.7 mln in equity capital.

text.p: Krause's Furniture Inc Tuesday said it received an additional $1.7 million in equity capital from its investor group.
"Following the close of the quarter, the company completed a new financing which measurably improved its financial position," Philip Hawley, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
"Up until the closing and throughout the second quarter, Krause's has been operating under liquidity constraints which have significantly affected operating results," he said.
"Being unable to stock raw materials to match bookings, sales have been lost or delayed, resulting in reduced revenues and lowered gross margins," Hawley said.
He said the capital infusion four weeks into the third quarter was helping the company move toward "timely order completion and customer satisfaction."
"Third quarter results will reflect the impact of past reduced liquidity, with standard patterns of operating results returning during the fourth quarter," he added.
